description.narrative: (Lebanon): .The Lebanon Investment Initiative (LII) activity provides equity and debt financing to small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and, more broadly, develops the ecosystems for lending, venture capital and private equity in Lebanon. Through LII, USAID provides technical support to investors on making informed-investment decisions, i.e., more precise methods to raise, organize, and invest private funds, as well as matching capital to invest in potential high-growth Lebanese enterprises within specific sectors/industries. With FY 2024 resources, LII will focus on job creation and sustainment, market-linkages for local products, and greater access to business support services and mentoring for local businesses and entrepreneurs. In addition to its investment activities, LII provides guarantees on investments made by angel investors and technical assistance to investors on best practices. Due to the protracted and deepening economic and financial crises, LII has established venture debt funds to provide working capital and long-term debt facilities to SMEs and access-to-finance mechanisms (specifically: convertible debt instruments) to SMEs of various growth stages, while also raising additional capital to meet debt financing demand. LII is also providing technical assistance to businesses that apply for or receive financing from LII on cost reduction measures, including assessing their energy consumption and recommending optimal consumption measures through energy audits. Last but not least, using FY 2024 funds, LII will invest in a fund poised for economic recovery that will extend working capital in the form of small-sized loans for businesses. .
